finding: Four resorts Wyndham's own property service files under its 'wyndham-vacations' brand segment (the Club Wyndham and WorldMark by Wyndham vacation-ownership clubs) were admitted to the qualifying hotel census and recorded VERIFIED_NO_PETS. They are vacation ownership, not hotels.
evidence_chain: Each property's own Wyndham property-service record and overview page place it under the brand route 'wyndham-vacations/...', and each overview page carries Wyndham's own notice 'WYNDHAM VACATION RESORTS REQUIRE A NIGHT MINIMUM STAY' (documents persisted by the source-ready Wyndham lane; hashes below).
Wyndham's own page for that segment is titled 'Wyndham Vacation Clubs'.

The clubs' own first-party sites describe them as vacation ownership: Club Wyndham's site is titled 'Club Wyndham Timeshare' and addresses its owners and their ownership; WorldMark's site addresses 'WorldMark owners' and their ownership, dues and loans.
